# Ripple Summary: Kubernetes-Deployment-Validation-Exit-Codes

## Specification
The deployment validation script repos/platform/scripts/validate-local-deployment.sh MUST return exit code 1 when deployment has failures (pods in CrashLoopBackOff/ImagePullBackOff, services without endpoints). Previously the script returned exit code 0 even when detecting failures, making it unusable for CI/CD pipelines.

**Annotation:**
```
SHARED COMPONENT - Used by multiple specifications:
- Kubernetes-Deployment-Validation-Exit-Codes (primary focus on exit codes)
- Local-Docker-Desktop-Kubernetes-Deployment (uses for post-deployment validation)

Both specifications are complementary and work together:
1. Local-Docker-Desktop deploys to docker-desktop (helmfile -e local sync)
2. Validation-Exit-Codes validates deployment with exit codes (this script)
3. CI/CD pipelines use exit code for automated decision-making

Exit code semantics (defined by Validation-Exit-Codes spec):
- Exit 0: Deployment healthy (all pods Running, all services have endpoints)
- Exit 1: Deployment has failures (pods not Running, services without endpoints)

Detection logic:
- Pods: grep -v "Running\|Completed" (catches CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff, Error, etc.)
- Services: awk '$2 == "<none>"' (detects services without backing pods)

Maintenance:

- Test exit code behavior in all scenarios
- Document any modifications in both spec traces
```
